tldr: Conditional inequality effects average rational Gini contrasts within fixed, heterogeneous strata. A balanced trial with many small strata can reduce assignment noise while preserving an irreducible nonlinear bias. The research kernel formulates the evaluated joint-frontier problem for original-record absolute error and exactly honest connected intervals with a deterministic maximal length, and proves its qualitative and fixed-size limits for every stratum count and every allowed stratum size. Its content is the constrained discrete rational inverse under complementary half sampling, together with conditional-noise control and separate complete-record converses. Supporting exponential-bias correction and qualitative consistency do not fix the sharp exponential scale or its transitions. A future prespecified discretized cohort trial on conditional food-consumption inequality is the consumer.
gap: Polyanskiy--Wu supplies applicable affine channel duality, and De Nicolò--Ferrante--Pacei supplies approximate Gini bias correction. The inspected results do not evaluate finite-stratum conditional Gini precision with complementary assignment, actual-score floor holes and unrestricted heterogeneous profiles.
fill: Open-ended Question 1 requires explicit evaluated rate functions, total attaining procedures and matching lower bounds for both losses. Open-ended Question 2 tests a sufficient stable-inverse route; instability leads to the declared regularized branch within the same experiment.
